instruction: Change the presentation layout to 'Widescreen (16:9)' format and verify all slides adapt to the new aspect ratio.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing presentation to 16:9 widescreen format. Evaluator checks slide width/height ratio is approximately 1.7778 (16/9) with 0.01 tolerance. Score is 1.0 if aspect ratio matches, 0.0 otherwise.

scoring_breakdown.1.00: Slide aspect ratio is 16:9 (1.7778 with 0.01 tolerance)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts presentation-level slide dimensions (width/height) from PowerPoint file using python-pptx library
Aspect ratio calculation (width/height) is mathematically correct with proper edge case handling (division by zero protection)
Metric correctly compares actual aspect ratio against expected 1.777777 (16/9) with appropriate 0.01 tolerance for floating-point precision
Expected value is semantically correct: 16/9 = 1.7778 represents the widescreen 16:9 format
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring presentation changes are persisted to disk

Complete coverage: In LibreOffice Impress/PowerPoint, all slides share the same presentation-level dimensions, so checking prs.slide_width/height correctly verifies that all slides have adapted to the new aspect ratio
Binary scoring (1.0 or 0.0) is appropriate for this verification task
